scenicChapters.narrative: For 43 km this is Burgundy Grand Cru Route, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: From the Great Saltworks of Salins-les-Bai → Lac de Chalain
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 41 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
